get.description:
The agreements the engine applies, by the symbol of the HTS special column, with the origins
each can apply to. A symbol does not establish eligibility: send it as preference, which
declares the rules of origin met. Needs the read permission; not counted.

example.condition: A symbol does not establish eligibility. Consult General Notes and the product's special column.

402.description: `access_required`: no active subscription; `quota_exceeded`: the quota is used up.

403.description: `forbidden`: the key lacks the permission, or the plan the API.

429.description: `rate_limited`: too many requests; wait the `Retry-After` seconds, until the window of `X-RateLimit-Reset`.

503.description: Unavailable for now: retry after `Retry-After` seconds. `service_unavailable` and `data_unavailable`, seconds; `edition_not_published`, the edition in effect on the date is not published yet: an hour, it can take longer; `billing_review`, the subscription needs support, without `Retry-After`: contact support. A batch is a 503 when every item meets it; when only some do, they have their error in `results`: send those items again.

post.description:
Every US duty and fee that applies to one product at a date, each with its official source. Without a customs
value, the duty rate when the duties are percentages. When something is missing to give a figure, the answer says what to send again.
Send save to keep the estimate. Needs the calculate permission; counted in the quota unless it gives no
figure of the duty: status needs_information, not_found, not_covered or unsupported.

parameters.description: Makes a request safe to retry, after a timeout for instance. Send a new unique value with each request (a UUID). If no response comes back, send the same request again with the same key: within 7 days, you get the first response, and the request counts once, and saves once. The same key with a different request is refused (409). An error response is not kept: the request sent again is calculated anew. A key belongs to its operation: on another route, it is a new key.

post.description:
Each item calculated on its own, as POST /v2/estimates would, in the order given: each is its own
declaration, so do not add their fees up; for several products entered together, use POST
/v2/estimates/entry. An invalid item refuses the whole batch (422, error.fields naming
items.<index>.<field>); an item that cannot be calculated (a date no edition covers) has its own error
in results, the others are calculated. The batch's publication_id, if any, holds for every item.
Counted as one request, whatever its number of items, unless none of them gives a figure of the duty.
When the data is unavailable for every item, the batch is a 503 to send again, neither counted nor kept
for its Idempotency-Key; when only for some, they have their error (data_unavailable) in results: send
those items again.

get.description:
The facts catalogue: each question a measure may depend on, by the name to answer it with in
facts, its type, its choices and its ordinary case. An answer names the ones it needs in
missing, and those it rests on in facts. Needs the read permission; not counted.

choices.label: Personal-use goods in a traveler's accompanied baggage
Entry claimed under a provision of chapter 98
Withdrawal from a foreign trade zone

facts.help: The calculator covers ordinary entries for consumption and withdrawals from warehouse for consumption. Personal-use goods in a traveler's accompanied baggage, goods entered under a provision of chapter 98 and withdrawals from a foreign trade zone follow other rules: other rates, duties assessed on values that differ from one measure to another, or duties kept on goods admitted to a zone before a suspension. They are not supported: declared, the result gives no estimate. Without a declaration, an ordinary entry is assumed, and the result says so.
